newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bourse approves Unipetrol main mkt listing.
newsitem.headline: Czech bourse approves Unipetrol main mkt listing.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange on Friday said it had approved a request from chemical and refining holding company Unipetrol a.s. for a listing on the bourse's main market.
"The listing committee of the Prague bourse decided on August 15 1997, to accept shares from the company Unipetrol for trading on the bourse's main market," a statement from the bourse said.
Unipetrol will be one of the most heavily capitalised shares on the bourse and the statement said the listing will take effect after standard admnistrative procedures have been completed.

The petrochemical assets of two former state companies Kaucuk and Chemopetrol were merged into the joint-stock company Unipetrol a.s., earlier in the year but the new mammoth company still needed to apply for a listing.

The refinery assets of Kaucuk and Chemopetrol were hived off in 1995 and merged to form Ceska Rafinerska a.s., a subsidiary of the new Unipetrol in which a western consortium of oil companies holds a 49 percent stake.

According to agreements by the companies' shareholders earlier this year, new shares of Unipetrol are to be issued at a 12-to-1 ratio for Kaucuk stock, while shares for Chemopetrol stock will be exchanged at an 11-to-1 ratio.
